phaseName: Define combined lens and run curriculum audit
goal: Extend PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md with the combined-lens rubric covering all 5 dimensions, then produce 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md containing the 22-folder scoring, the 02_Data_Structures per-file scoring, the threshold rule, the flagged-files list, and the future-ferment roadmap.
summary: Phase 1 complete: produced the curriculum pedagogy audit foundation. (1) Extended 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md with new 'Combined Lens: Depth + Breadth' section containing 5 dimensions × 4-5 measurable sub-checks each, plus scoring scale, threshold rule (avg<2.0 OR any-dim=0), and explicit 'Preservation Guarantees' block protecting 5W1H (D014). (2) Added permanent rule D014 to 00_CONTEXT/DECISIONS.md naming 5W1H as protected backbone. (3) Created 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md (348 lines) with header, scoring methodology, 21-folder scoring matrix sorted ascending, per-folder notes, priority ranking (P0=5, P1=5, P2=11), 21-item roadmap for future ferments, audit caveats, and per-file 02_Data_Structures appendix with 16-row scoring matrix, 16 numbered P2-UPGRADE entries ready for phase 2 consumption, and preservation notes. (4) Verified rubric references, folder scores, per-file scores, threshold rule, flagged list, and roadmap are all present and structured.
stepSummaries:
1. Append a new section to 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md titled 'Combined Lens: Depth + Breadth' that defines 3-5 measurable sub-checks per dimension (conceptual depth, topical breadth, production reality, historical evolution, pedagogical craft). Each sub-check must be script-checkable or human-checkable in <60 seconds. [verified]
  2. Create 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md with header (date, scope, lens version), reference to the rubric, scoring matrix for all 22 folders (5 dimensions each), priority ranking, and a roadmap of recommended next-ferment targets. Use representative-file sampling at folder granularity. [verified]
  3. Add a 02_Data_Structures appendix to the audit document with per-file scoring for every file in 02_Data_Structures/, an explicit threshold rule (e.g., files scoring below X on any dimension OR averaging below Y overall are flagged), and a flagged-files list ready for phase 2. [verified]
  4. Append a 'Roadmap for Future Ferments' section listing the remaining 21 folders in priority order with one-sentence rationale each, derived from the audit scores. [verified]
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
